title: Usage standards
intro: How much of a consumable a unit of planned work uses. Work orders turn these into a consumable plan.
emptySub: Add one, for example welding rod per dia-inch welded.

archiveConfirm.title: Archive this standard?
archiveConfirm.body: It stops applying to new plans. Plans already generated keep their figures, and you can restore it later.

form.itemLocked: To change the item, archive this standard and add a new one.
form.workUnitHelp: Matched to the contract line unit, ignoring case and spaces.
form.workUnitRequired: Enter the unit of work, for example dia-inch.
form.prefixHelp: Leave empty to apply to every contract line with this unit.
form.qtyInvalid: Enter a quantity above zero, up to 6 decimals.
form.marginHelp: Added on top. Leave empty for none.
form.duplicate: A standard for this item, work unit and code prefix already exists. Edit that one instead.

plan.title: Consumables
plan.empty: No consumable plan yet. Generate one from the usage standards.
plan.emptyClosed: No consumable plan was made for this work order.
plan.outOfDate: The work or the usage standards changed since this plan was made. Material requests use the allowance until the plan is regenerated and approved.
plan.outOfDateAction: Regenerate to bring it up to date, then request approval.

approval.unknownAuthor: This older plan needs to be edited or regenerated before it can be approved.
approval.stale: The inputs changed since approval. Regenerate and request approval again.
approval.pcmAuthorRoute: an Admin or this project's Project Manager

plan.noStandardTitle: No standard for these contract lines
plan.noStandardHelp: A gap in the standards, not a need of zero.
plan.previewBody: Adjustments and their reasons are kept. Requests already sent keep the figure they were judged against.
plan.previewError: Couldn't work out the new plan. Try again.

errors.CUS_NOT_FOUND: This work order is not available.
errors.CUS_FORBIDDEN: You cannot plan consumables for this work order.
errors.CUS_WORK_ORDER: The work order is closed or cancelled.
errors.CUS_SOD: The person who made the plan cannot approve it.
errors.CUS_APPROVER: You are not an approver for this plan.
errors.CUS_PLAN_MISSING: Generate or edit the plan before asking for approval.
errors.CUS_PLAN_STALE: Regenerate the plan before asking for approval.

form.addTitle: Add an item to the plan
form.qtyInvalid: Enter zero or more, up to 3 decimals.
form.reason: Why is this different from the standards?
